title: The Rule of Two Premium Positioning
rules: Never launch a high-ticket or premium service tier unless it combines at least two tiers from the Rich Desire Pyramid.
If you sell Convenience, pair it with Exclusivity (e.g., concierge service limited to top 10 clients).
If you sell Status, pair it with Scarcity (e.g., bespoke product runs with an active waitlist).
If you sell Privacy, pair it with Convenience (e.g., full-service discretion handlers).
